top_choice_rationale: Adonis (P002) is my first choice on literary grounds. The case is a decades-long, sustained remaking of Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and critical dialogue with inherited forms, with a distinctive voice. The citation should rest on the poetry alone, not on the essays or his public role. I accept the main objection: the committee can judge Arabic prosody only through translations and secondary accounts, and the later poetry is less certain than the major collections. I treat that as a limit on our evidence, not a measure of the achievement. It applies equally to the prose of Cărtărescu (P001), so I would not let it decide the ranking either way. Cărtărescu is second because the claim rests on the Blinding trilogy and Solenoid, where the architecture is the point, and that can be tested on the major works. My doubt about whether the very long late novels are evenly sustained remains unresolved, so he stays below Adonis. Carson (P003) is third. Her voice and formal invention are real and directly legible in English, and her continuity of concerns across forms answers part of my earlier reservation. I still weigh sustained transformation of a literary language somewhat above reconfiguration of genre, and I hold that as a contestable judgment, not a finding. A citation for her would also have to stay with her own writing and not lean on book-object design. P000 is last because none of the three leading candidates has evidence so thin that withholding the prize is warranted. All three rest on public knowledge and translation, without independent verification, and I would welcome Arabic-language and Romanian-language readings under identical questions.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my scholarly work on modern poetry, the fragment, exile literature and translation (including Celan) is context only. The profile records no personal, professional or archival tie to Adonis, Cărtărescu or Carson. As chair I note that B007 is my own first preference and that nothing in the profile establishes my votes.
